mustKnows.q: What wash care advice would you give a customer? (any three products)
a: Indigo / Overdye: cold or mild warm water, wash inside-out, wash with like colours, dry in shade
Flat-knit / Knits: hand or gentle machine wash in a wash bag, lay flat in shade, no rubbing, high spin wringing or heat
Embellishment: hand wash inside out in cold water in a wash bag - no scrubbing, wringing, bleach or machine dry
Prints (flock, HD, silicone, embossed, tufting): gentle cold wash inside out - avoid heat, rubbing, high spin, and don't iron directly on the print
Textured fabrics (sponge, high-grade texture): gentle cold hand wash or wash bag, no rubbing, wringing or heat, reshape and dry flat in shade
Coated / water-repellent finish: cold gentle wash inside out without fabric softener in a wash bag - no bleach, heat or dry cleaning, air dry in shade

mustKnows.q: What is the difference between Pinpoint, Double Count and Premium Oxford?
a: Pinpoint Oxford: fine basket-weave cotton / cotton blend - the lightest, most versatile everyday Oxford, works casual and formal
Double Count Oxford: finer double-ply (2/2) yarns, denser and smoother - softer, more durable and more refined than Pinpoint
Premium Oxford: heavier 3x3 Oxford with higher GSM - richer texture, fuller drape, the most premium Oxford
In short: Pinpoint = everyday | Double Count = softer & refined | Premium = heaviest & richest
